title: Holding fees accounting discrepancy when collateral is less than fees
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When a highly leveraged trade accumulates positive PnL over time, an accounting discrepancy occurs in how holding fees are handled, leading to potential fund loss for the protocol.  The issue arises in the `realizeHoldingFeesOnOpenTrade` function when `holdingFeesCollateral` exceeds `availableCollateralInDiamond`.
